programmes.funder: ProInnóvate, Ministerio de la Producción, Peru
programmes.amount_note: 19 regional competitions launched in 2026 to fund projects transforming regional productive sectors. A related set of three concursos was announced to finance up to 160 projects with a combined S/9 million, implying average awards in the tens of thousands of soles.
programmes.deadline_note: Each regional competition has its own closing date published on the ProInnóvate calendar; the first 2026 regional round has already announced winners (10 startups in Cusco).
programmes.reopen_note: ProInnóvate ran 19 Concursos Regionales in 2026 with staggered windows. If your region's window has closed, check the calendar for the next round; the programme has repeated regional cycles annually.

procedure_steps.detail: Find your region's competition on the ProInnóvate calendar.
Register in the ProInnóvate online system.
Submit the project before the regional closing date.

eligibility.other_note: Applicants must operate in the specific region running the competition.

programmes.source_snippet: ProInnóvate del Ministerio de la Producción del Perú anunció a las 10 startups cusqueñas ganadoras de la primera convocatoria de los Concursos Regionales 2026

programmes.funder: ProInnóvate, Ministerio de la Producción, Peru
programmes.amount_note: Non-reimbursable co-financing for innovative ventures, historically up to around PEN 140,000 for the Emprendimientos Innovadores category (with lower ceilings for Emprendimientos Dinámicos and higher for scale-up categories), against a 25% counterpart.
programmes.deadline_note: ProInnóvate publishes a public calendar of concursos with specific opening and closing dates. The 13th edition (13G) of Emprendimientos Innovadores appears on the calendar alongside regional competitions.
programmes.reopen_note: ProInnóvate maintains a rolling annual calendar at https://calendario.proinnovate.gob.pe/ listing every concurso and its window, including 19 Concursos Regionales launched in 2026. If the national window is closed, a regional one may be open.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the ProInnóvate calendar for the open concurso and category.
Register the entity in the ProInnóvate system (En Línea).
Submit the project with budget and counterpart evidence before the closing date.
Evaluation and pitch; on award, sign the contract and execute with milestone disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Evidence of innovation and market validation

eligibility.other_note: Peruvian-registered companies, generally under four years old with limited revenue; individual entrepreneurs must incorporate to receive funds.

programmes.source_snippet: Emprendimiento - StartUp Perú. Concurso Emprendimientos Innovadores 13G.
